decisions.reason: A core piqué upholstery fabric with its own website page, launched in 2023, typically stays in the collection for several seasons.
The double-face wool-blend fabric is still recent and fits the decoration range, though its blend content and lower website prominence raise moderate withdrawal risk.
The wool bouclé leno aligns with the shift toward renewable materials, but it is a semi-transparent bouclé like the withdrawn Product B, so its risk is somewhat elevated.
Launched in 2024 with its own page and usable for both upholstery and curtains, it is too new and versatile to withdraw.
